Maneuvering

Budget Energetico Ormeggio

The total kinetic energy allowed for a vessel to safely berth, accounting for mass, speed, and fender capacity to prevent damage.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Budget Energetico Ormeggio?

In this glossary, Budget Energetico Ormeggio refers to: The total kinetic energy allowed for a vessel to safely berth, accounting for mass, speed, and fender capacity to prevent damage.

How is Budget Energetico Ormeggio used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Calcolare il budget energetico di ormeggio prima dell’avvicinamento per assicurare che la capacità dei parabordi non venga superata al contatto."

Definition

The total kinetic energy allowed for a vessel to safely berth, accounting for mass, speed, and fender capacity to prevent damage.

Operational example

Calculate berthing energy budget before approach to ensure fender capacity is not exceeded during contact.

Localized term
